title: opencode-code-review findings
description: The output contract of opencode-code-review's /code-review at medium and above (a JSON array of findings, ranked most-severe first, capped per level, [] when nothing survives verification). The low level's one-line contract (`path:line — text`, or `(none)`) is normalised into this same shape by findings.py: summary carries the line, failure_scenario repeats it, and verdict is absent because low runs no verify pass.

file.description: Repo-relative path of the file the finding is in.

line.description: 1-indexed line the finding anchors to (0 when the model gave none).

failure_scenario.description: Concrete inputs/state → wrong output/crash, or for cleanups the concrete cost.

verdict.description: Optional: the verify pass's vote, when the model reports it. Phase B (fix) applies CONFIRMED findings and skips PLAUSIBLE ones with a stated reason.
